name: BSP_MenuInterface_ServicePendingRequests

For each of DAT_00e198ac and DAT_00e198b4, when the object's +0x3C flag is set it compares two index pairs ([1] vs [8] and [7] vs [0xE]), calls vtable+0x10 with the two target indices to service the difference, and writes 1 through the out pointer. name: BSP_AttractScreen_Deactivate

Reached through the vtable slot 0 thunk CG_scalar_deleting_dtor_00689ba0/00689e60; 004e3aa0 BSP_Game_OnInit releases DAT_00e198bc through virtual +0 when it enters game state 3, so the screen exists only in the front end.

name: BSP_Game_UpdateBlockingScreen
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. Provisional. Sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4b3b with the raw frame delta, guarded by DAT_00e198bc != 0. When that object's +0x3C flag is set afterwards the frame runs BSP_GuiManager_Update, BSP_Game_Render and BSP_Game_FinishRenderFrame and returns at 004e4b8c, skipping the entire simulation: the loading/modal screen frame. Menu-interface segment 28. | Packet game_blocking_screen_frame: body recovered from the listing 00689cc0-00689d8b. __thiscall, ECX = DAT_00e198bc, one float stack argument, RET 4, two epilogues. hold = BSP_InputDeviceTable_AnyDynamicDeviceButtonDown(DAT_00f8bbf4) | BSP_InputDeviceTable_AnyJoystickButtonDown(DAT_00f8bbf4), both always evaluated; while byte this+0x3c is clear it also ORs in (byte this+0x48 == 0) and byte 5 of the 00425d10 singleton. If hold, this+0x44 = 45.0f (DAT_00ce3d60); else this+0x44 -= min(delta, 1.0f) (DAT_00d7a24c), one x87 FLD/FSUB/FSTP on float32. Then if this+0x3c is set and hold, virtual +0xC (BSP_AttractScreen_Deactivate) runs and, when DAT_00e198c8 is non-null, that object's virtual +8; if this+0x3c is clear and this+0x44 < 0.0f and *(DAT_00e188a8+0x5d4) is none of 0xd, 0x10, 0x11, virtual +8 (BSP_AttractScreen_Activate) runs. The object is the front-end idle attract screen: its constructor loads the GUI layout FE_attract and its activate plays movies/PacificTheme.bik, so this is an idle timeout, not a loading gate.

name: BSP_AttractScreen_Activate
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_blocking_screen_frame, read-only analysis. Provisional. Virtual +8 of vtable 00cf78e8, called from BSP_Game_UpdateBlockingScreen at 00689d87 when the idle countdown at +0x44 goes negative. Runs the base activate 00684700 (which sets byte this+0x3c = 1 at 0068477a), makes the GUI layout at +0x40 visible through its virtual +0x34(1), sets bytes +4 and +5 of the movie player DAT_00e18d48 and calls 004f83b0 and its virtual +0x18, then builds the pooled string 'movies/PacificTheme.bik' (00cf7908) and passes it to 004f8a20(&path, 1, 1.0f, 1). So the attract screen is the idle front-end movie.

name: BSP_InGameInterface_IsBaseScreenActive
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = DAT_00e198c4, RET: returns this+20h == 32h || this+20h == 31h. The interface-id name table at 00e08cd8, which 006881f0 and 00689030 index by menu+20h to print INTF_* trace strings, decodes 31h as INTF_SHIPYARD and 32h as INTF_AIRBASE, so this asks whether a base-management screen is up. name: BSP_InGameInterface_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = DAT_00e198c4, no stack arguments, RET at 0068cc68. Sole caller is the interface-only branch of the simulation gate at 004e5252, guarded by DAT_00e198c4 != 0 and its +3Ch. Naming it after the audio environment understates it: the environment switch is only the tail. The body first runs a spectator/free-camera block guarded by 004bca50(game) in {4,5,6,7}, walking the unit list at [[game+19CCh]+58h] and driving byte +8h of [00e198c4]+BCh; then handles action 5Ah into INTF_FREECAMERA through 004cc460(29h,0); then a run of rising-edge tests on actions 89h, 8Ah, C1h, D6h, FBh, FCh, 108h and 4Bh. The tail at 0068cb79 picks one of Cockpit, Air (the pointer at 00ce9b1c) or Underwater and passes it to 00a7b710, whose only caller this is, then calls 004c1e90(0Ch) and 00427190(0Ch). Air requires the camera at game+19FCh to be strictly above the water height 0078cf20 returns and the device-capability flag at 0068cc0a to be clear; the two terms are combined with a byte AND, not a short circuit. Evidence: docs/GAME_SIMULATION_GATE.md.
